data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google Places SDK using native platform libraries.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to access Google Places autocomplete and other SDK features via the native libraries on each platform. It avoids HTTP requests, allowing API‑key restrictions on Android and iOS. Web support uses the Maps JavaScript API.
use_when: You need Google Places autocomplete with native SDK integration
You want to restrict your API key to specific apps
You target multiple platforms (Android, iOS, web, desktop)
avoid_when: You only need a simple HTTP‑based places request
strengths: Uses native SDK for better security
Cross‑platform plugin covering mobile, web, and desktop
weaknesses: Web usage requires enabling Maps JavaScript API
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, provide your Google API key when creating FlutterGooglePlacesSdk. For web, enable Maps JavaScript API in Google Cloud. No additional native build steps beyond standard plugin setup.
